address: HOU3 11003 Corporate Centre Dr. Houston, TX 77041
HOU4 5160 Westway Park Blvd. Houston, TX 77041

reading.body:
The CyrusOne HOU3-HOU4 campus publishes 84 MW of IT capacity across 347,000 square feet of technical space at two addresses in the 77041 zip code of Houston. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 84 MW of IT load is roughly 2,100 racks, and at 10,000 accelerators per 100 racks that assumption chain would imply around 210,000 GPU-class slots, but neither figure is the operator's claim. The average power density across the published technical space works out to approximately 242 watts per square foot, which is consistent with a mixed-use colocation footprint rather than a purpose-built hyperscale AI training shed, though the actual deployment mix is not published.

The campus carries a Green Globes certification. That certification addresses the environmental and energy efficiency design of the buildings, qualifying the campus for tenants with sustainability reporting requirements, and says nothing about redundancy tier, uptime commitment, or AI workload readiness, none of which are published in the spec data.

Among the 133 Houston-area and Texas facilities this site has mapped, only 8 publish a megawatt figure, and those 8 together total 315 MW of published IT capacity. HOU3-HOU4 accounts for 84 of those 315 MW, which is roughly 27 percent of the published total, and it ranks first among all facilities in the state for which this site holds a published figure. That rank reflects the limits of what operators disclose publicly as much as it reflects the campus's actual scale, because most mapped facilities publish no capacity number at all.
